title: Agbrte — an agent workbench with durable, bridge-owned sessions
description: An agent workbench in which sessions belong to a per-workspace host process rather than to the window watching them. The host owns the append-only event log and the permission gate, so a run survives the app closing, is reachable from a second machine, and can execute on a remote target over SSH while the interface stays local. Includes a transport layer that refuses localities it has not implemented rather than silently running work elsewhere, and a capability model that distinguishes what an adapter declares from what has been observed.
